account.description: Account label; the vault id is cookie:<credential_domain>:<account>. Required for: capture_login.

browser.description: Browser target, default own; user selects the person's Chrome.

browser_session_id.description: Own-only session id from launch; user close takes none. Required for: close.

credential_domain.description: Login-capture site; fetch_url/login_url must be HTTPS on it or a subdomain. Required for: capture_login.

fetch_url.description: URL of the authorized post-login page. Required for: capture_login.

hazards.description: Hazards disclosed to the person before an origin grant is minted. Required for: open_grant.

image_height_px.description: Echoed screenshot dimension; coordinates are meaningful only in the exact frame the model saw. Required for: click_point.

image_width_px.description: Echoed screenshot dimension; coordinates are meaningful only in the exact frame the model saw. Required for: click_point.

intent.description: Short reason for the action, for policy and audit. Required for: navigate, click, click_point.

login_url.description: Login page the person is handed; login is observed on its origin. Required for: capture_login.

max_bytes.description: Snapshot: cap on state_text bytes, cutting navigation before main content.

mode.description: Snapshot: actionable (default; outline or zoom), ax or dom_full.

origin.description: Origin for own login tools or one site to revoke (omit to revoke all); canonical origins only. Required for: present, import_login.

origins.description: Canonical HTTP(S) origins to authorize. Required for: open_grant.

otp_ref.description: Ref of the one-time-code field, if the form has one.

password_ref.description: Ref of the password field. Required for: fill_login.

point.description: Pixel in the echoed screenshot; it is meaningful only with that image's required width and height. Required for: click_point.

x.description: Horizontal window pixel from the left edge.

y.description: Vertical window pixel from the top edge.

read_page.description: Return the landing page's outline in state_text, as snapshot does.

ref.description: Element reference returned by the named snapshot. Required for: click, type.

role_filter.description: Keep matching roles, case-insensitively (button; AXButton also works). Default mode only.

secret.description: Name of the saved login in the person's vault. Required for: fill_login.

severity.description: Declared interaction severity for authorization checks. Required for: navigate, click, click_point.

severity_tier.description: Optional ceiling tier 1-4. After hazard_not_disclosed, copy detail.grant_request.severity_tier.

snapshot_id.description: Snapshot identifier that prevents acting on stale page data. Required for: click, click_point.

tab.description: User tab handle. With browser:user, required on every page action. Own calls never accept tab. Required for: claim_tab.

text_filter.description: Keep label/value matches beneath labelled ancestors. Default mode only.

url.description: URL to navigate to. Required for: navigate.

username_ref.description: Ref of the username or email field. Required for: fill_login.

wait.description: Use settle to wait for page stability before reading, or none to return immediately.

zoom.description: Snapshot: a printed ref; expands its subtree while it exists on the same page.

input.text: Text kept only on the page

row.source:
export const action = input.action == "snapshot" ? "Read page" : input.action == "navigate" ? "Navigate" : input.action == "click" || input.action == "click_point" ? "Click" : input.action == "type" ? "Type" : input.action == "screenshot" ? "Screenshot" : input.action == "open_tab" ? "Open tab" : input.action == "claim_tab" ? "Use tab" : input.action == "fill_login" ? "Fill login" : input.action == "open_grant" ? "Request approval" : input.action == "present" ? "Sign in" : input.action == "resume" ? "Resume" : input.action == "import_login" ? "Import login" : input.action == "capture_login" ? "Save login" : input.action == "revoke_access" ? "Revoke access" : input.action == "launch" ? "Open browser" : input.action == "close" ? "Close browser" : input.action == "scroll" ? "Scroll" : input.action == "status" ? "Status" : Replace(input.action, "_", " ")
export const authority = Last(Split(First(Split(First(Split(First(Split(Last(Split(view.record.site ?? input.url ?? "", "://")), "/")), "?")), "#")), "@"))
export const host = StartsWith(authority, "[") ? First(Split(authority, "]")) + "]" : First(Split(authority, ":"))
export const outcome = view.completion.outcome ?? view.record.outcome
export const reason = view.completion.outcome == null ? view.record.reason : view.completion.reason

<Card appearance="clear" direction="row" gap="s" align="center">
<TextContent text={action} maxLines={1} />
<Slot width="fill">
<TextContent text={host} size="small" maxLines={1} />
</Slot>
<Slot width="short">
{outcome == "held" ? <Badge text={reason == "login_handoff" ? "Signed out" : "Asked you"} tone="neutral" /> : outcome == "error" ? <Badge text="Refused" tone="danger" /> : outcome == "partial" ? <Badge text="Unknown" tone="warning" /> : outcome == "success" ? <Badge text="Done" tone="neutral" /> : null}
</Slot>
<Slot width="short">
{outcome == null && view.call.phase == "running" ? <Elapsed start={view.call.startedAtMs ?? now} /> : view.completion.durationMs == null && view.record.durationMs == null ? null : <TextContent text={FormatDuration(view.completion.durationMs ?? view.record.durationMs ?? 0)} size="small" maxLines={1} />}
</Slot>
</Card>
